name: io.github.iowarp/lmod-mcp
title: CLIO Lmod
description: Lmod MCP - Environment Module Management for LLMs with comprehensive module operations

tools.name: module_list
tools.description: List all currently loaded environment modules.

tools.name: module_avail
tools.description: Search for available modules, optionally filtered by name pattern.

tools.name: module_show
tools.description: Display detailed information about a specific module.

tools.name: module_load
tools.description: Load one or more environment modules into the current session.

tools.name: module_unload
tools.description: Unload one or more currently loaded modules from the environment.

tools.name: module_swap
tools.description: Swap one module for another atomically.

tools.name: module_spider
tools.description: Search the entire module tree comprehensively for matching modules.

tools.name: module_save
tools.description: Save currently loaded modules as a named collection.

tools.name: module_restore
tools.description: Restore a previously saved module collection.

prompts.name: setup_environment
prompts.description: Guided workflow for setting up an HPC software environment.
